conclusions.subject: walkthrough
conclusions.text: Re-affirmed on the unchanged raw; the receipt repair touched no artifact, and the host chain now anchors at the bound entry itself: Model.forward (solution.py 83-99) accepts case 5 because qk_dim 512 is in {512,576} and heads 128 <= 128, skips the out=None allocation since the caller supplies out, and makes the single s4_tc_forward call with the caller's out and float scales. Trace of fixed case 5 (16 requests x 3 rows = 48 tokens, head_count 128, qk_dim 512, page_size 64, topk_budget 512, random/scattered): token_count 48 > 32 defeats the split predicate and dim 512 defeats tail/cluster, so aka_s4_indexed_m64_d512 launches with smem 191104, clusterDim {1,1,1}, block 512 and grid 48*ceil(128/64) = 96 = Worker_count, each CTA preassigned one item; item w maps to token w/2 and head group w%2, matching mapped_query_idx = w/head_groups and head_idx = my_row + (w%2)*64. Per row seq_lens = sparse_mla_top_k_lens = min(visible,512) = 512, so active_topk = 512, tile_count = 4, two id passes stage exactly 512 ids with no filler positions (128*4 = topk_budget). LOAD fills q_slot (32768B, both head groups in range) and per tile issues 128 gather4 announcing 65536B into kv_ring slot n%2; QK issues 16 products per tile into tmem columns (n%2)*128 with the first product initializing, committing k_empty and s_full; SOFTMAX takes the full-tile fast path (valid_sparse_cols = 128, clean ballots), merges half maxima, publishes rescale(n), stores the E4M3 prob tile and accumulates the unrounded per-half row_sum; PV issues 8 products per tile into columns [256,512) through the transposed descriptor on the same kv slot, committing k_empty, p_empty and o_full so the KV slot needs both commits; CORRECTION releases o_slot for tile 0, conditionally rescales tiles 1-3, waits o_full of tile 3 and sum_ready, merges half sums, forms inv and writes 64x512 bf16 per item guarded by head_idx < 128 (all pass). The two items per token cover all 128 heads, so 96 items cover every element of the 48x1x128x512 output with no global intermediate and untouched scratch buffers; on the 148-SM acceptance machine all CTAs are resident, try_cancel returns no cancel, every role exits after one item on refill_exhausted, the five tmem users signal and warp8 deallocates the 512 columns. First-round, steady-state, last-round and terminating-reply situations are each exercised.

Per call the host encodes the 4-D query map (box {128,64,1,1}) and the 2-D physical-row cache map (box {128,1}), both SWIZZLE_128B/OOB_FILL_NONE (which also zero-fills tail head rows), raises the max dynamic smem attribute to 191104 once per device, and launches via cudaLaunchKernelExC with the explicit single-CTA cluster dimension and spread policy. conclusions.text: Passes on the unchanged approved raw. Content stays within design-necessary material: the filler sentence adds exactly the source fact needed to make the gather model well-defined for the topk_budget = 2052 corner without importing staging-code detail; the two Forbid entries document concrete repeatable risks (dead branches physically present in the fixed source) with cost-based Reasons and no process narrative; the meaning-only Symbol entries carry no redundant duplication. No process state, revision history or prior approvals appear in the YAML; the kept research trade-offs (the approximate-primitive unknown bound, the zero-tile source limitation, the dead-residue exclusions, the consumerless final_max) remain the sanctioned kind of recorded source restrictions, each tied to a design consequence; describes operate at design granularity, leaving swizzle bit forms, descriptor encodings, parity algebra and thread layouts to implementation.

handoff: Receipt repair only — root.yaml Version 4 (sha ac417412...) stays approved exactly as landed; no artifact or judgment changed, and the repair adds the missing host-category anchor on the bound entry solution.py::Model.forward (83-99) with renumbered conclusion indices. P3→P4 carries forward unchanged: (1) P4 materializes the two planned nodes the checker still reports missing (split8_merge.yaml, cluster_m128.yaml) and finalizes dispatch.md — the root row's '精确 when 待 P3 写实' note is fulfilled by Dispatch.when (qk_dim = 512 outside the split selection); the residue sentence should absorb the dead four-column tcgen05.ld into _tmem_load_0 never read (kernel_m64.cuh:805-806), the unused softmax/corr warp-pair exchange regions at 166912/167936 (1536 bytes, named in the smem Require), and the unused s_seeded/q_pair_ready/kv_pair_ready/pv_pair_ready/tmem_dealloc_peer barriers. (2) Naming anchors P4/P5 must reuse: roles INDEX, LOAD, SOFTMAX, CORRECTION, QK, PV, SCHED; indices u/d/n/r/g; storages q_slot, kv_ring, index_ring, prob_ring, tmem_acc (views raw_score(n) columns (n%2)*128..+128, value_acc columns [256,512)), rescale_slot, sum_slot, final_max_slot, reply_ring; math symbols active_topk, tile_count, sel_id, valid, raw_score, ssl, row_max, rescale, prob, prob_e4m3, row_sum, value_acc. (3) For P5: cluster_m128 must not inherit root's numeric path (no -8 prescale, max-hysteresis bound, dequantized-mass row sum per the catalog row); split8_merge shares the kernel_m64.cuh body under S4_SPLIT=1 but replaces the epilogue with raw fp32 partial/stats writes plus the merge kernel, changing the output producer and needing its own Work_schedule steps and Handoff, and its empty-split filtering via s4_split_has_work means root's zero-tile Forbid wording must not be copied verbatim. (4) Documented unknowns no root claim depends on: the exact TMEM lane/column packing behind i_desc 69206032/71368720 and the 16x32bx2/32x32b load patterns, the D576 tail box(128B)-over-64-feature zero-fill semantics (tail record scope), and the smem P/epilogue swizzle bit forms. (5) The zero-tile work-item barrier mismatch remains a located source limitation carried in Forbid #1 and the catalog paragraph; kernel-issue registration is the Supervisor's decision, and schema approval does not assert the source kernel is correct.

summary: Receipt repair only; the decision and the artifacts are unchanged. The prior approve was rejected for a missing bound host entry anchor: inputs.host and implementation_source both bind to candidate/solution.py::Model.forward, but my host-category evidence cited only launch.cu. Evidence index 1 now anchors the bound host entry in the host category (solution.py 83-99: the qk_dim/head_count guard, the candidate-only out=None allocation, the single extension call forwarding every contract argument plus the caller's out and float(bmm1_scale)/float(bmm2_scale), and the return of the same buffer object), while index 0 keeps the implementation-category anchor on the same symbol (63-101, including __init__ binding self._call to s4_tc_forward); the launch.cu entries follow as the call chain, and all conclusion indices were renumbered against the 58-entry array. I re-verified the current workspace before resubmitting: root.yaml is byte-identical to the approved raw (sha ac417412..., identical effective identity and region digests), dispatch.md is unchanged, and the check helper returns exit 0 with raw_passed true and no pending corrections. The semantic judgment stands as approved: Version 4 fixed all three revise issues (the filler-gather sentence now matches kernel_m64.cuh:324-339, the residue Forbid is split with correct Item↔Choice correspondence, and active_topk/tile_count have a single Math definition), and the unchanged Work_schedule/Tile_pipeline regions remain as verified line-by-line against the fixed source.
